name: BilibiliComics
text:
#!name=哔哩哔哩漫画
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partB/BilibiliComics.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
bilimanhua_enable = switch,true,false,tag=哔哩哔哩漫画-脚本开关

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/i\d\.hdslb\.com\/bfs\/fawkes/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/i\d\.hdslb\.com\/bfs\/manga-static\/\w+\.(?>jpg|png)$/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/i\d\.hdslb\.com\/bfs\/manga-static\/\w+\.(?>jpg|png)@1200w_1500h_1e_1c/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/comic\.v\d\.Comic\/(?>Recommend|MoreRecommend|Flash|ListFlash|GetBubbles|GetActivityTab|GetCommonBanner|GetComicConfigPicList|SearchBanner|AppInit)/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/comic\.v\d\.Shop\/GetShopItems/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/user\.v\d\.SeasonV\d\/GetSeasonInfo/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/user\.v\d\.Read\/ActInfo/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/novel\.v\d\.Novel\/MoreRecommend/i then reject_dict(200)


[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/user\.v\d\.User\/UCenterConf/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/bilibiliManga.js") with enable=${bilimanhua_enable}, tag="哔哩哔哩漫画", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/user\.v\d\.User\/GetInitInfo/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/bilibiliManga.js") with enable=${bilimanhua_enable}, tag="哔哩哔哩漫画", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/comic\.v\d\.Home\/HomeFeed/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/bilibiliManga.js") with enable=${bilimanhua_enable}, tag="哔哩哔哩漫画", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/manga\.bilibili\.com\/twirp\/comic\.v\d\.Comment\/Main/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/bilibiliManga.js") with enable=${bilimanhua_enable}, tag="哔哩哔哩漫画", timeout=60, requires_body=true


[MITM]
hostname = manga.bilibili.com, i*.hdslb.com
